INSERT INTO pcd_share_resource_table ( share_resource_id, share_id, space_id, resource_type, file_id, node_id ) VALUES
( #{item.share_resource_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{item.share_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{item.space_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{item.resource_type}, #{item.file_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{item.node_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.share_resource_id, r.share_id, r.space_id, r.resource_type, r.file_id, r.node_id, r.created_at, COALESCE(f.file_name, d.node_name) AS resource_name, COALESCE(f.file_size, 0) AS resource_size, f.file_type AS file_type FROM pcd_share_resource_table r LEFT JOIN pcd_file_info_table f ON r.file_id = f.file_id AND r.resource_type = 'file' AND (r.space_id = f.file_space_id OR (r.space_id IS NULL AND f.file_space_id IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table d ON r.node_id = d.node_id AND r.resource_type = 'folder' AND (r.space_id = d.node_space_id OR (r.space_id IS NULL AND d.node_space_id IS NULL)) WHERE r.share_id = #{share_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND () ORDER BY r.created_at ASC

SELECT r.share_resource_id, r.share_id, r.space_id, r.resource_type, r.file_id, r.node_id, r.created_at, COALESCE(f.file_name, d.node_name) AS resource_name, COALESCE(f.file_size, 0) AS resource_size, f.file_type AS file_type FROM pcd_share_resource_table r LEFT JOIN pcd_file_info_table f ON r.file_id = f.file_id AND r.resource_type = 'file' AND (r.space_id = f.file_space_id OR (r.space_id IS NULL AND f.file_space_id IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN pcd_directory_tree_table d ON r.node_id = d.node_id AND r.resource_type = 'folder' AND (r.space_id = d.node_space_id OR (r.space_id IS NULL AND d.node_space_id IS NULL)) WHERE r.share_resource_id = #{share_resource_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND ()

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM pcd_file_info_table f WHERE f.file_id = #{file_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND (f.file_space_id = #{space_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} OR (#{space_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} IS NULL AND f.file_space_id IS NULL)) AND f.file_status = 'active' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_share_resource_table r WHERE r.share_id = #{share_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND (r.space_id = #{space_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} OR (#{space_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} IS NULL AND r.space_id IS NULL)) AND ( (r.resource_type = 'file' AND r.file_id = f.file_id) OR ( r.resource_type = 'folder' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c WHERE c.ancestor_id = r.node_id AND c.descendant_id = f.file_node_id AND (c.closure_space_id = r.space_id OR (r.space_id IS NULL AND c.closure_space_id IS NULL)) ) ) ) )

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM pcd_directory_tree_table d WHERE d.node_id = #{node_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND d.node_user_id = #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND d.node_status NOT IN ('trashed', 'deleted') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_share_resource_table r WHERE r.share_id = #{share_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} AND r.resource_type = 'folder' AND (r.space_id = #{space_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} OR (#{space_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler} IS NULL AND r.space_id IS NULL)) AND ( r.node_id = d.node_id OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pcd_directory_closure_table c WHERE c.ancestor_id = r.node_id AND c.descendant_id = d.node_id AND (c.closure_space_id = r.space_id OR (r.space_id IS NULL AND c.closure_space_id IS NULL)) ) ) )
